trigger: A multi-slot latent pool achieved excellent semantic cosine while all learned slots collapsed to cosine approximately 1.0.
lesson: An unnormalized log-sum-exp used as a smooth maximum can reward duplicate slots because the value grows with log(slot_count). A set objective must not improve merely because the same target-aligned representation is copied into more slots.
general_rule: For multi-slot/set representations, test objectives explicitly against the duplicate-copy adversary: one perfect useful slot versus N identical perfect copies should not improve the semantic set reward unless multiplicity is itself meaningful.

trigger: Independent standard cross-attention allowed every latent slot to consume the same evidence and unrestricted slot self-attention reinforced homogenization.
lesson: If distinct latent carriers are a functional requirement, independent attention queries alone do not guarantee specialization. Introduce competition/assignment structure over evidence and measure specialization rather than assuming learned query vectors will differentiate.
general_rule: Use competitive normalization or another causally binding mechanism when multiple latent slots must preserve complementary evidence; retain slot permutation symmetry and avoid hard-coded semantic labels unless grounded data warrants them.

trigger: A failed 12-slot model could superficially be interpreted as insufficient model capacity.
lesson: Do not scale parameter count to mask a known objective or interaction bug. Repair the incentive/mechanism first, then use post-fix evidence to decide whether capacity is a bottleneck.
general_rule: Classify failure source before scaling: objective defect, validator defect, architecture symmetry, data gap, optimization instability, then capacity. Scaling remains allowed whenever corrected evidence shows a real capability bottleneck.

trigger: High pooled/best-slot semantic scores coexisted with complete multi-slot collapse.
lesson: A component must be evaluated on the capability it exists to provide, not only on an easier downstream proxy. Strong aggregate semantic readout cannot validate a multi-slot architecture whose slots are redundant.
general_rule: Pair task-quality metrics with structural/causal metrics tied to the component's purpose, such as centered effective rank, evidence specialization, missing-input safety, and counterfactual use.

trigger: Only the latent component failed while upstream parent/fusion caches came from ratified frozen components.
lesson: Reuse immutable upstream caches only after verifying their hashes against checkpoint lineage. Fresh-initialize the failed component instead of recomputing unrelated parents or resuming collapsed weights.
general_rule: Failure-driven retraining should mutate the minimum justified layer of the stack while preserving verifiable upstream artifacts; broaden adaptation only when evidence requires it.
